project.tagline: Every Match. Your Server. No Compromise.
project.brand_description: A premium British football streaming service that grants direct access to a proprietary server pre-loaded with a firmware streaming kit — built for serious supporters who refuse to miss a single whistle.
project.target_audience: British football fans, 18–45, who distrust overpriced broadcasters, value technical reliability, and have tribal loyalty to their club
project.vibe: Dark stadium atmosphere meets precision engineering. Think the tension of a 90th-minute winner overlaid with the cold confidence of server infrastructure. Not flashy — lethal. The design should feel like you're already inside the stadium tunnel, kit on, seconds before kick-off.

design_direction.aesthetic_pole: Cinematic dark minimalism with raw industrial texture — the love child of Apple's product obsession, Linear's developer-grade precision, and the visceral physicality of a sold-out Anfield night match
reference_brands: Apple — product confidence, zero clutter, hero moments that convert
Linear — dark UI, tight typographic rhythm, developer-grade trust signals
Stripe — clear value hierarchy, premium documentation energy, conversion-optimised sections
Sky Sports — emotional football ownership, broadcast authority

palette_mood.base: Pitch black with a near-imperceptible warm undertone — not #000000 but #0A0A0B, like stadium concrete at midnight
palette_mood.secondary: Gunmetal grey (#1C1C1E) for card surfaces and section separators
palette_mood.accent_primary: Flare green (#AAFF45) — the moment the goal goes in, the net lights up. Used sparingly: CTAs, live indicators, hover states only
palette_mood.accent_secondary: Signal white (#F5F5F0) for headline copy — slightly warm, never cold clinical white
palette_mood.texture_tint: Deep amber grain overlay at 4% opacity across all hero sections — evokes old terracing photographs, adds tactile warmth
palette_mood.forbidden_colors: No purple gradients. No sky blue. No generic SaaS teal.

typography_mood.display_font: Bebas Neue or Monument Extended — compressed, tall, aggressive. Headlines should feel stamped onto the page like a match programme. Tracking: tight to negative.
typography_mood.body_font: Sora or DM Mono — clean, slightly technical, reads well at small sizes against dark backgrounds
typography_mood.accent_font: A condensed serif like Playfair Display Condensed for pull-quotes or score tickers — adds editorial gravitas
typography_mood.hierarchy_rule: Display at 96–144px for hero. Section titles at 64px. Body at 16–18px. Never more than 3 type sizes visible at once per section.
typography_mood.text_treatment: Headlines split across two lines with a hard left-align. Important words in accent green. No centred body copy.

hero_moment.description: Full-viewport dark scene. A looping, near-silent WebM of stadium floodlights flickering on, shot from pitch level — desaturated, grain-heavy, almost cinematic black and white except for the green of the grass. Over this, in massive compressed white type, the headline SMASHES in word by word with a subtle motion-blur stagger (not bounce — slam). Below it, a single line of green monospace text types itself out character by character: 'Server connected. Firmware loaded. Match starting in 00:03:41.' A single pill-shaped CTA button in flare green reads 'GET YOUR KIT →' — on hover it pulses once like a heartbeat and the cursor becomes a crosshair.
hero_moment.motion_details: Parallax depth: video scrolls at 0.4x speed creating depth as user enters scroll. Headline words arrive at 60ms staggered delay each. The countdown timer is live JavaScript.
hero_moment.emotional_target: The user should feel the pre-match electricity — heart rate ticks up, they lean forward, hand already reaching for the CTA.

scroll_motion_system.philosophy: Layered, purposeful, never decorative. Motion should reveal information like a slow-motion replay — each element earns its entrance.
techniques: Intersection Observer triggered fade-up with slight Y translate (32px → 0) at 0.6s ease-out for all section content
Section backgrounds shift hue by 2–3 degrees on scroll using CSS custom property interpolation — imperceptible but subliminal
Stats and numbers count up from zero when entering viewport — scroll-triggered CountUp.js
Feature cards enter with a staggered cascade: card 1 at 0ms, card 2 at 120ms, card 3 at 240ms
A sticky pitch-line progress indicator (thin flare-green horizontal rule) tracks scroll position from 0% to 100% of page at the very top
On the pricing section, the recommended plan has a slow breathing box-shadow pulse — alive, not static

sections.description: Minimal dark nav bar, blurred glass background (backdrop-filter: blur(20px)), KickStream wordmark left in white. Right: 'How It Works', 'Pricing', 'Sign In' in small caps, spaced tightly. CTA pill 'Get Started' in flare green. On scroll past hero, nav slides down with a 0.3s ease transition from above.
As described in hero_moment above. Mobile: video replaced by a static dark gradient with a grain overlay. Headline stacks vertically. CTA full-width.

Dark gunmetal bar below hero. Infinite horizontal marquee of trust signals in small white caps, separated by flare-green bullet points: '12,000+ ACTIVE STREAMS', 'COVERAGE: ALL PREMIER LEAGUE FIXTURES', 'LATENCY UNDER 3 SECONDS', 'BRITISH SERVERS. BRITISH FOOTBALL.', 'NO CONTRACT. CANCEL ANYTIME.' Scrolls left at medium pace, pauses on hover.

Left: a dark device mockup (laptop or smart TV) showing the streaming UI mid-match — crowd noise waveform visible, HD badge glowing green. Right: three stacked feature lines, each with a green icon, bold compressed headline, and one-sentence body. Features: (1) 'YOUR OWN SERVER' — dedicated hardware, not shared bandwidth; (2) 'FIRMWARE KIT INCLUDED' — plug in and stream, zero technical experience needed; (3) 'ALL KICK-OFF TIMES COVERED' — from 12:30 Saturday to Monday night.

Three steps displayed in a row, connected by a dashed green line like a tactical formation diagram. Step 01: Choose your plan. Step 02: Receive your server + firmware kit in 48hrs. Step 03: Plug in, log on, never miss a match. Each step has a large white step number, short headline, micro body text. On mobile: stacks vertically with connector line becoming vertical.

Three massive numbers centred on a near-black background: '4K QUALITY', '3s LATENCY', '99.9% UPTIME'. Numbers count up on scroll. Below each, a single descriptive line in small body text. Background has a subtle radial gradient glow behind the centre stat — like a stadium spotlight from above.

Cards on dark gunmetal background. Three tiers: Terrace (monthly, basic), Season Ticket (annual, most popular), Boardroom (multi-device family). The Season Ticket card is elevated 16px above siblings, has a green 'MOST POPULAR' badge clipped to top-right corner, and has the pulsing box-shadow animation. Pricing in large compressed type. Feature lists use green checkmarks. CTA buttons: outlined for Terrace, solid green for Season Ticket, solid white for Boardroom.

Three testimonials displayed as editorial pull-quotes, not review cards. Large opening quotation mark in flare green at 120px. Quote text in condensed serif italic. Attribution in monospace small caps. Backgrounds slightly offset in grey tone — creates a staggered grid feel. Real-feeling British names and clubs: 'Gary T., Tottenham fan, Watford', etc.

sections.type: LIVE MATCH TICKER — the signature unexpected element
sections.description: A section that looks exactly like a real live match scoreboard dashboard, showing today's/upcoming Premier League fixtures with live scores (static demo data styled to look live). Clubs rendered with subtle crest placeholders, half-time/live/FT badges in green. This section functions as a product demo AND social proof simultaneously. It's interactive — hovering a match shows 'STREAMING NOW on KickStream'. This breaks every expectation a SaaS landing page sets and immediately answers the question: 'does it actually work?' The section headline above it reads: 'THIS IS WHAT YOU'RE MISSING.' in 96px compressed white type.

Dark background, left-aligned questions in medium white type. Expand/collapse with a green + → × icon. Answers in slightly dimmed body text. No borders — uses vertical spacing as separator. Questions include: 'Do I need technical skills?', 'Is this legal and licensed?', 'What football competitions are covered?', 'How fast is shipping?', 'What happens if my server has issues?'

Mirror of the opening hero but inverted emotionally — this is post-match, celebrating. Dark gradient with a single flare of stadium light from top-right. Massive headline: 'THE MATCH STARTS WITH OR WITHOUT YOU.' Subheadline: 'Join 12,000 fans who chose their own stream.' Two CTAs side-by-side: 'GET YOUR KIT NOW' (green filled) and 'SEE PRICING' (outlined white). Below CTAs, a single line: '📦 Ships within 48 hours. No contract. Cancel anytime.'

KickStream wordmark. Left: nav links. Centre: social icons (X, Instagram, YouTube). Right: legal (Privacy, Terms, Contact). Bottom line in tiny monospace: 'Built for British fans. Powered by our servers. Not theirs.' Thin green rule above footer as final flourish.

texture_details.grain_overlay: SVG noise filter at 3–5% opacity over hero and CTA sections — adds tactile depth, prevents the 'flat digital' look
texture_details.surface_variation: Cards use #1C1C1E with a 1px border of rgba(255,255,255,0.06) — barely visible but adds dimension
texture_details.glow_effects: Flare green radial glows (box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(170,255,69,0.15)) used on: active CTA button, live badge, featured pricing card
texture_details.stadium_light_flare: CSS radial gradient from rgba(255,220,100,0.04) to transparent, positioned top-right corner in hero and final CTA — mimics floodlight warmth
texture_details.pitch_line_motif: Thin white dashed lines used as decorative dividers — references painted pitch markings, keeps football soul in the UI geometry

technical_requirements.framework: React with Tailwind CSS — or pure HTML/CSS/JS with CSS custom properties
technical_requirements.fonts: Google Fonts: Bebas Neue (display), Sora (body), DM Mono (code/labels)
technical_requirements.animations: CSS keyframes for hero entrance and stat counters. Intersection Observer for scroll reveals. No external animation libraries required unless Motion (Framer) is available.
technical_requirements.video: WebM looping, muted, autoplay, playsinline — with fallback static image for mobile
technical_requirements.performance: Lazy load all below-fold sections. Preload hero font and video poster. Target LCP under 2.5s.
technical_requirements.responsive: Mobile-first. Hamburger nav on mobile. Hero headline at 56px mobile. All grids collapse to single column.

copy_tone.voice: Direct, tribal, technically confident. Talks to fans as fans. No corporate softness. Contractions always. Short sentences hit harder.
signature_phrases: Built for the 90 minutes that matter.
